metrics.case_exact: fraction of records with every question right

formula.chance: expected score of uniform random answers: mean of 1/K over questions (accuracy), mean over records of the product of 1/K (case_exact)
formula.skill: clip((score - chance) / (1 - chance)) with unanswered questions scored wrong; area = mean of its datasets; index = 100 x mean of the five areas
formula.calibration: ECE (10 bins) and Brier on the returned probabilities of answered questions, per dataset, area and pooled

uncertainty.unit: record, resampled within each dataset, paired across systems
